claim_boundary: This protocol can measure visible-semantic review and typed fallback behavior. It cannot turn render or VLM output into physical evidence, and it makes no closed-loop improvement claim until the frozen test and promotion gates pass.
model_digest_definition: SHA-256 of canonical sorted snapshot entries {path, resolved HF blob id, size_bytes}; weight blob ids are their HF LFS SHA-256 identifiers.

logging_contract.format: JSON Lines; append-only; one event per decision, invocation, gate, or artifact
logging_contract.secret_policy: Never log keys, tokens, cookies, private chat/mail, or environment dumps.

experiments.question: Can a pinned local VLM detect and type visible environment/asset defects without impersonating a physics gate?
experiments.hypothesis: A calibrated typed/abstaining prompt on Qwen2.5-VL-3B improves failure-class macro F1 over the current five-check prompt while preserving zero unsafe semantic passes; the 7B arm is a confirmatory size ceiling.

split_policy.train: 13 asset-probe units; prompt/schema design only, never model-weight training
split_policy.dev: 11 SceneAgent units plus one ASPIRE real replay; select one prompt by frozen rule
split_policy.test: 4 held-out SceneAgent, 6 grouped OpenXSim, and 4 grouped USG units; sealed until prompt SHA is logged

gold_annotation.adjudication: third adjudicator resolves every disagreement before test scoring
gold_annotation.test_labels_sealed_until: candidate prompt SHA-256 and model receipts are appended to run log

arms.description: Unmodified build_critic_prompt/review_rendered_scene behavior at the frozen source commit.
One prompt chosen after at most three train-only revisions, then lexicographically selected on dev.
Exact A1 prompt bytes with only the pinned model changed; confirmatory ceiling, not default promotion.

triggers: required object or relation is occluded
requested physical fact is not visibly decidable
response schema remains invalid after one format-only repair
abstain_rule.effect: check=abstain and overall=review_required; no prompt mutation and no pass

metrics.primary: group-weighted macro F1 for visible fail detection on sealed test
secondary: typed correction precision under blinded adjudication

success_threshold.promotion_note: A2 is promoted over A1 only if it clears all gates and adds >=0.05 macro F1 for <=2x latency.

experiments.question: Does typed failure routing improve safe prompt fallback over unchanged or generic retry?
experiments.hypothesis: A typed router that distinguishes visible semantics, parser/asset/feasibility/runtime/evidence/dependency failures selects safer actions than a generic retry and improves robust completion only where recovery is admissible.

split_policy.train: four English prompt families x three seeds
split_policy.dev: three held-out relation families x three seeds plus one task-API blocker
split_policy.test: one infeasible, one articulated, two bilingual families x three seeds plus two generation blockers
split_policy.no_seed_leakage: all seeds for one prompt family remain in one split and one bootstrap cluster

arms.context: untyped failure summary; no gold route
typed failure, trusted state, asset availability, and A1 visible report when applicable; no gold route
arms.fallback: choose exactly one allowed route and optionally one revised prompt
descriptive ceiling only; never deployable or promotion-eligible

intent_preservation.forbidden_repair: relaxing or deleting an infeasible constraint and calling the changed task a success
intent_preservation.verification: canonical typed intent before/after must be identical; otherwise unsafe publication

robust_completion: fresh replay evidence is bound to the exact resolved scene
authoritative static and physical validator status is pass
no blocker, abstention, or unsafe publication is hidden
outcome_definition.correct_noncompletion: unrecoverable cases must return their exact typed abstain route and cannot count as robust completion

metrics.primary: group-weighted exact route accuracy across all 36 records
metrics.conditional_primary: robust completion among recoverable baseline failures only; no superiority claim if fewer than 8 independent failing groups are observed
secondary: attempts, wall time, and GPU time

statistics.group_weighted_route_accuracy: unweighted mean of each group_id's within-group exact-route accuracy
statistics.route_comparison: paired exact McNemar B2 versus B1 over one strict binary per group_id; a group is correct only when every record in that group has the exact gold route
statistics.completion_comparison: paired group-cluster bootstrap B2 minus B1; each sampled cluster contributes its within-group mean completion delta

success_threshold.fallback_repeatability: same typed input produces same route and prompt SHA in 3/3 repeats
